mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pet WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY is_active DESC, id DESC
SELECT p.*, c.name AS owner_name, c.phone AS owner_phone FROM pet p JOIN customer c ON c.id = p.owner_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND c.is_active = 1 ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pet p JOIN customer c ON c.id = p.owner_id
AND (p.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.phone LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet(owner_id, name, species, breed, gender, birthday, weight_g, is_neutered, color, habit, is_active, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{name}, #{species}, #{breed}, #{gender}, #{birthday}, #{weightG}, #{isNeutered}, #{color}, #{habit}, 1, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet SET is_active = #{active} WHERE id = #{id}
